utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the repair drive is getting a good turnout today — folks are bringing in all kinds of things to fix up. If you’re going, I can walk over with you.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Is it really? I’m not sure it’s worth going unless they’re actually fixing things today.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yeah, that’s what I heard — they’ve got volunteers set up and should be fixing stuff on the spot. If you want, we can swing by together and see for ourselves.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’m planning to bring the repair drive details around to folks nearby and make sure everyone knows when and where to show up.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — thanks for doing that. Just let me know when it’s happening and I’ll try to swing by.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Will do — I’ll circle back with the time and place as soon as I’ve got it nailed down.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good — what’s the first repair you want me to help with?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Let’s start with the loose porch step — it’s the one I’ve been meaning to fix.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I can help with that — I’ll grab a pry bar and some screws and meet you by the porch.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’m happy to help with the repair drive—what do you need most right now?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Rey — we could really use screws, duct tape, and a few basic tools right now.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can bring screws and duct tape, and I’ll check my toolbox for a few basics too.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help coordinate around the school schedule—what time window are you thinking for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That’d be a big help—how about late Saturday morning, say 10 to 12?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That should work for me—I can help line up the school-side timing around 10 to 12 on Saturday. If you want, I can also spread the word to a couple of other parents.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’m happy to help with the repair drive. Let’s keep it simple: tell me what needs doing first, and I’ll stick to the plan.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Eli — first thing is sorting the donations and making a quick list of what still needs fixing. I’ll keep it simple and we can take it one step at a time.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That works for me. I’ll sort the donations and make the list, and then we can go from there.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I’m spreading the word about the repair drive—if you’re free, come by and bring a friend!

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I can probably stop by, but I need to check the timing and whether I can manage to bring someone too.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: No rush at all—just let me know what works for you. If bringing someone’s tricky, you’re still very welcome to swing by yourself!

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I heard the repair drive is happening soon, but I’m still piecing together the details. Did you know if they need volunteers or donations?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Yes — we’ll need both volunteers and donations. I can get you the exact list of needed items and the time slots if you’d like.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Yes please, that would help a lot — I’m still catching up on the details.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you share the repair drive details again so I make sure I have everything right?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Of course — I can send the repair drive details again. What part would you like me to resend?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Please resend the date, location, and what items you want people to bring.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can help, but I’ll need to see the repair drive details first.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sure — I’m running late as usual, but I’ll bring the repair drive details over now.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Dane. Bring them by when you can, and I’ll take a look.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, Mina — if you need any tools for the repair drive, I’m happy to lend a hand.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Gus. Do you have a hammer and some spare screws I can borrow?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yep, I’ve got both — I can bring them by anytime you need.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I don’t have any repair drive details yet—what location are we heading to?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh right—I'm not sure yet. Let me check and get back to you.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Sounds good—just let me know the location when you have it.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — I can lend a hand with tools if you need them for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Gus. I’d appreciate that — I’ll stop by when I’m ready.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good, Rey — just come by when you’re ready and I’ll have the tools set aside.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m happy to help, but I’d like to know the timing and where everything needs to go first.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Right, can you confirm when the repair drive starts and where folks should drop things off?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’d want the start time and exact drop-off spot before I can help organize anything. If you have those details, I can share them with the neighbors.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m happy to help spread the word about the repair drive—what do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Jules — could you share the date, time, and what kinds of repairs we’re taking? If you can post it in the neighborhood chat, that’d be a huge help.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — send me the details and I’ll post them in the neighborhood chat right away.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ve got a list going for the repair drive, so I can check what we still need. Tell me what’s already covered, and I’ll keep track from there.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m a bit late, but I can help—what’s still on the list?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Dane — I’ve still got a few gaps to fill, so tell me what you can bring and I’ll mark it down.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, the repair drive is coming along nicely — folks have been dropping off tools and a few volunteers already signed up. I’ll keep you posted if I hear anything new.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That’s great to hear, Tess. Thanks for keeping me posted—I’ll make sure our school schedule stays clear in case more help is needed.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Will do, Faye — I’ll let you know as soon as I hear if they need extra hands or a schedule change.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure — what do you need from me for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Bo — I could use your help making a quick list of the homes that need repairs and checking who can donate tools or time.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I can do that — I’ll jot down the homes and ask around about tools and time.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I’m happy to help with the repair drive. What do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Sam—could you help sort donations and carry the heavier boxes?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely, Leo — I can sort the donations and help carry the heavier boxes.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I’m putting the repair drive on everyone’s radar — if you’re free, come by and bring a friend.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks for the heads-up — I’m still catching up, but I’ll try to stop by and bring someone if I can.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect — I’ll keep you posted, and no pressure if you can’t make it. If you do swing by, I’ll be glad to see you both.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I can help keep track of where the repair drive is happening—do you want the exact location or the best route there?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: The exact location would help me most, thank you. If you can add the best route after that, I’d appreciate it too.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Sure — send me the exact address or cross streets, and I’ll add the easiest route right after.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hey Hana, are we still on for the repair drive this weekend?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I think so, but let me double-check the details first. What time and place did we settle on?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I don’t think we picked a final time and place yet. Want to choose one now?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, right—how’s the repair drive going so far?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, it’s going okay—I’ve gathered a few things, though I keep misplacing the list. I’m still on it, promise.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: No worries, that happens. Want me to help you remember what’s still missing?
